findings.description: Direct inspection of the current V30 front, back, sit, and crouch renders confirms the separated overskirt panels do not create continuous lap coverage. In sit, the shorts remain plainly exposed across the raised thighs; in crouch, shorts remain visible beneath the lifted front panels. Pointed panel ends intersect and overlap around the thighs. This is an observed coverage failure, not accepted fit.

The current neutral front and rear renders show dense coarse triangular facets and irregular folds across the skirt and jacket. The skirt hem is uneven, and panel boundaries end in sharp protruding corners. The resulting silhouette and surface transitions are visibly unfinished.
The current rear render does not show a clearly identifiable rear adjustment tab or buckle at the waist; no readable hardware silhouette is visible.

The build report records source-coordinate UV attribution on 23,703 faces, but the current source-bound mesh showcase reports uvStatus MISSING and lists garment meshes without a UV layer, including the pleated overskirt and static garment mesh. No UV-layout image was reviewed. UV coverage and placement therefore remain unverified.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V30 propagates declared 2D source coordinates through crease splitting and triangulation, and the build report attributes authored UV coordinates to 23,703 faces across 26 tiles. Direct visual review of the current renders still finds coarse surface faceting, irregular hems and pointed panel intersections, exposed shorts in sit/crouch, and no readable rear tab/buckle. The source-bound mesh showcase reports UV MISSING with garment objects that lack UV layers, so complete mesh UV coverage is not established. This prototype has no accepted fit, Shape Key, motion, Unity/VRChat runtime, or release evidence.

nextAction: Revise the sewn skirt pattern and construction so the front panels provide controlled continuous coverage in sit and crouch without pointed overlaps; improve skirt surface and hem topology; make the rear adjustment tab/buckle visually legible; and ensure every garment mesh has authored UV data. Then rebuild, inspect all five views and six poses directly, and regenerate the current source-bound topology/UV showcase. Fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat execution, packaging, and release remain unverified.
